A clear, readable, powerful silhouette for a small phone screen; the whole body commits to the motion. Eyes open.

Background: 100% solid flat magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no floor, no shadow. Centered, the whole character, hammer and shield fully inside the image with a wide magenta margin on all four sides. Clean anime game sprite, crisp lines, same rendering as Image 1. No motion blur, impact flash, dust, cracks, glow, particles, speed lines, text or labels.
